demo.trade: Residential and light commercial heating, cooling, and refrigeration

preferences.label: NO DISCOUNTS
preferences.detail: Never cut the price to close. Hold the number. Sell the calendar and the work.
preferences.note: Dale’s rule. Written on the shop whiteboard.

opportunities.title: Stale estimate · Rivera 4-ton heat pump
opportunities.story: Complete 4-ton heat pump changeout. Elena wanted it in before the last heat wave. The estimate went out. Nobody called back. The number is still good.
opportunities.whyNow: Shoulder season is closing. If this sits another week it becomes a spring job — and $6,850 leaves September.

opportunities.title: Incomplete quote · Brookside Café cooler + RTU
opportunities.ageLabel: Draft started August 22 · missing after-hours labor
opportunities.story: Walk-in cooler repair plus rooftop changeout. The equipment is priced. After-hours labor never got a line. The café cannot take a weekday shutdown, so the quote is unsendable.
opportunities.whyNow: Owner asked twice. An incomplete quote is a no. Finish the labor line and send a firm number.

opportunities.title: Overdue tune-ups · 8 commercial accounts
opportunities.ageLabel: Last PM April · fall window opened August 11
opportunities.story: Eight light-commercial accounts: a dental office, a salon, a credit union, two offices, a daycare, a bakery, and a small warehouse. Fall preventative maintenance was never booked. $330 each.
opportunities.whyNow: First cold snap is when these calls become emergencies — at emergency prices Dale does not want, and at hours the crew does not have.

opportunities.title: Stale estimate · Patel attic furnace
opportunities.story: 80% furnace in a tight attic, plus a humidifier they asked to price. They were waiting on a date, not a cheaper number.
opportunities.whyNow: Nights are already in the 40s. This is a this-week install if someone offers a morning slot.

opportunities.title: Overdue tune-ups · Harper duplex
opportunities.story: Landlord account. Two systems, two overdue visits at $210. Last year the south unit iced because the filter sat.
opportunities.whyNow: Small money, easy yes, and it keeps a landlord who sends three houses a year.

opportunities.title: Incomplete quote · Lakeshore Inn rooftops
opportunities.story: Two rooftop units quoted without startup, commissioning, or the first-year PM. The inn manager will not sign an incomplete number. Revenue Bloom held this back until it learned how Northgate likes to follow up.
opportunities.whyNow: Shoulder-season rooftop work still fits the calendar. A complete, firm quote — no discount — is the move.
